name: Signed C2PA provenance (c2pa-python) + runtime dev cert

outputs: bytes with embedded ES256-signed C2PA manifest

summary: Embeds a signed C2PA manifest (c2pa.created, trainedAlgorithmicMedia, ai_generated assertion). Dev CA and signer are generated at runtime in $FBSWAP_HOME, key is mode 0600, and the CA key is discarded. Production certs come via env. verify() reports Trusted/Valid/Invalid/missing.
